subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-40, paired with v1-p136-1. (C)WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what world-expansion means when crossed with the progressional continuance of black creativity, given that AFI(1) — the transformation principle introduced in the preceding passage — has just been named. Besides the main line to PROG-CONT, WO-EXP-PRI branches to TR-INFO (trans-information) → SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics), and to TRS (transition). TRS branches to ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism), to MT-INFO (multi-information) → ATTN (attraction), and to CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) → AFL (affinity alignment) → PART (participation). The structural claim: world-expansion crossed with progressional continuance runs *both* through trans-information into spiritual dynamics *and* through transition, which produces alternative composite progressionalism, multi-information, and a culture-solidification chain into participation.
